Method of Attack: Deploys destructive malware that deletes shadow copies, event logs, disables Windows services, deletes OS backups, disables recovery console, wipes mapped file shares, and shuts down the machine
Steals browser credentials from Internet Explorer, Firefox, and Chrome
Steals system credentials from Windows LSASS using Mimikatz-like technique
Spreads laterally using stolen and hardcoded credentials via PsExec and WMI
Generates new binaries with harvested credentials for propagation
Impacted Systems: Windows PCs used by Olympics organizers and journalists
Attack Vector: Credential theft and lateral movement using PsExec and WMI
Indicators of Compromise: Deletion of shadow volume copies using VSSAdmin
Deletion of OS system backup catalog using WBAdmin.exe
Disabling pre-boot Windows recovery console using BCEdit.exe
Deletion of System & Security Windows event logs
Use of hardcoded credentials and newly harvested credentials in malware binary
